The changelog: block scalar format in each persona YAML matches the pattern required by @mistralys/persona-builder v2.6.0 resolveChangelogMeta(). comments.note: personas/package.json uses file:../../ai-persona-builder for @mistralys/persona-builder. This is valid in the co-located monorepo workspace but will break npm install in any environment where only ai-insights is checked out (CI, Docker, fresh developer clone). Before any release of ai-insights that ships the personas system, ai-persona-builder v2.6.0 must be published to the npm registry and personas/package.json updated to '^2.6.0'. Recommendation: create a dedicated pre-release WP or include this step in the Release Engineer's scope for this feature.

The personas/package-lock.json now encodes the file: path (../../ai-persona-builder). This is correct npm behavior for a file: dependency, but it means the lock file is environment-specific. Switching to a published semver range will produce a portable lock file — another reason to resolve the file: dependency before release.
